scope: Actual browser exported static design pose. STEP is checked through the shipped CAD worker, with preserved world coordinates, against native history independently transformed into world coordinates. STL is an approximate triangle mesh: stream, finite coordinates, nondegenerate triangles, welded closed manifold edges, four connected components, world bounds and oriented volume. This does not establish imported editable feature history, mate or material retention; native project Save is separate.

reproduction.note: The exact checker source is embedded below so this one-off download audit remains auditable. Resolve repo and input download paths or use the copied tracked fixtures, then run with the workspace tsx loader.

portabilityCorrection.description: The original export audit found a browser/Node rocker-angle rounding difference of 2.842170943040401e-14 degrees. That original pre-fix mismatch remains recorded above. The corrected physical matcher accepts only finite machine roundoff and retains exact types, object key sets and array order; there is no decimal quantization.

focusedTests.coverage: Actual Chrome Save and explicit 2.84e-14 degree roundoff accepted; 1e-8 geometry, joint and angle edits rejected, along with nonfinite data, sparse coordinates, type/key and order changes.
